summary: Known community.docker issue: docker_container's per-network MAC address may be ignored by the Docker daemon when the network is attached after container creation.
questions: Why is the MAC address I set in docker_container not applied?
Does docker_container honor a network MAC address when attaching networks later?

answer_card.title: docker_container MAC address ignored
answer_card.answer_md: If you set a MAC address for a container's network and that network is attached after the container is created (for example, during idempotency handling), the Docker daemon may ignore the MAC address.
